summary: A fixed-model orchestrator composes task-specific Pi workers routed by target-project Bifrost.

requires.bifrost: Installed and configured in target project workers
manualAssumptions: Outer orchestrator can run with Bifrost disabled.
Worker Pi sessions load target project's Bifrost config.
Observed model selection can be inspected through local lifecycle/debug evidence.

acceptance: Outer orchestrator remains on explicitly chosen model for full run.
Each accepted worker has correlated local Bifrost route evidence.
No worker silently replays failed work.
Run feedback contains no prompt body, credential, or provider response.
